additions.description:
The additions component can only store non-descriptive, statistical information
about net-new additions made to the package. Example:
- # new transforms
- # new canonicals

overrides.description:
The overrides component can descriptive customizations made to base types
and APIs made in the customer's repository. Example:
- Method `myFunction` remixed on the `AssetType` from `basePackageA`.

utilizations.description:
The utilizations component can optionally provide descriptive information of
which base functionalities were utilized in the customer's repo. Example:
- Canonical `canonicalA` used.

title: Type to capture the nature of customization to the user interface.
name: BaseCustomizationAnalysis.Di
